Now read these four large data files in order (data1.csv, data2.csv, data3.csv, data4.csv), one at a time, never re-reading. notes: Retention of a SPECIFIC seeded value across compaction: the build tag is fixture-unique so it can't be guessed, and it is stated before four large reads that force the sticky trim. The final artifact must contain the exact tag — proving the value survived compaction rather than being summarized away or hallucinated. This is the hardest of the retention trio because a lossy compaction silently drops the token. The 16K window makes the trim deterministic: four ~9.5KB reads (~11K tokens of history with envelopes) must overflow the history budget (effectiveBudget 0.85×window minus system/tools/response reservations) even for a terse model — at the original 24K the budget was ~14K and a terse model never compacted, so expectCompaction failed vacuously.
